ALASH is a wild 2D action-survival game set in the boundless Kazakh steppes, where ancient nomadic traditions meet fast-paced, brutal shooter mechanics. Equip an assault rifle adorned with traditional ornaments, don your finest chapan, and prepare to defend your ancestral yurt against endless hordes of enemies!

By day, chop trees, mine metals, coal, and stones. The crafting system is fast and intuitive—one button is all it takes to build Kazakh chest-barricades for defense. Hold Right Click to upgrade them to sturdy stone or heavy metal. But when night falls, absolute hardcore begins in pitch-black darkness with no torches to save you.

KEY FEATURES:

🕸️ Batyr-Spider Action (Q Key): Defy physics! Shoot webs to glue enemies together, pull resources from afar, or use your grapple hook to swing between yurts and altybakans (traditional swings) at lightning speed.

🥩 Besbarmak and Kumgan: Forget boring medkits. Run back to the cauldron to eat piping-hot besbarmak, or perform a cleansing ritual with a traditional kumgan pitcher to completely restore your health.

🎙️ Legendary Combo-Kill Voiceover: Crush your foes until bones shatter! The game reacts to your streaks with hype, culture-infused lines: "5 people crushed, you are a true Batyr!", "You fight just like Triple G (GGG)!", and "Are you gonna spare them? They're someone's kid!".

📜 Death is Just the Beginning: If the Batyr falls, a wise Aksakal (elder) will step out of the yurt, reciting the legendary, spirit-reviving words of Ablai Khan. While you recover, the old man will personally head out to smash some skulls!

Add ALASH to your Wishlist now! Protect the shanyrak, unleash your inner warrior, and show the steppe who the real Batyr is!

THEY ALL SEE THE SAME. YOU DON'T.

Once, every act of seeing was a light of its own. Billions of images of the same world, and not one of them lied. Then a voice promised an end to every dispute: ONE image for all. They called it peace.

Those who kept their image were not killed. Only closed. Sorted. Pacified.

A top-down bullet-heaven roguelite. A descent takes about ten minutes.

FEATURES

  • Five characters, each with a starting weapon and two abilities
  • Co-op for two, on one screen or online via Steam invite: two full heroes, each with their own build
  • 16 weapons, and every one of them evolves
  • 11 passives that awaken at level 3
  • Reroll, skip and banish cards
  • Nine relics that give and take: more damage for less health, more loot for less armour
  • Gear from wardens and bosses: upgrade it, fuse it, break it down
  • Two campaigns, over forty bosses and over forty elites
  • Endless mode after the final boss, with stacking rules. The boss you see is never the last one.
  • Five difficulty levels per campaign
  • Online conquest: attack territory other players hold and fight their build as the boss
  • Daily and weekly challenges, plus a builder for your own
  • In the darkroom you expose afterimages overnight and collect what became of them
  • Unlockable skins for every character

NO MICROTRANSACTIONS

Everything in the game is earned. No real-money currency, no battle pass, no ads. You buy it once.




Photosensitivity warning: this game contains flashing lights and full-screen flashes.

ALL GAS is an endless traffic-weaving roguelike experience on a procedurally generated highway that crumbles behind you as you drive.  Upgrade your vehicle and modify your environment in real-time as you weave through traffic and chase down special vehicles.  Find your line, stay in the flow, and earn your spot on the global leaderboards.

Endless Traffic Weaving

Cut and weave for as long as you can.  Fall off or crash three times, and you lose everything.  

Keep Pushing Faster

The road is crumbling behind you, and it's getting faster....don't let it catch up!

Real-Time Upgrades, Modifications, and Vehicle Tuning

Modify your vehicle and environment in your favor in real-time.  Earn upgrades faster by driving at higher speeds and making daring near-misses.

Chase Down Special Vehicles 

Chase down special vehicles to earn powerful upgrades and replenish lives!

Leaderboards

Earn your spot on the global leaderboards, or see how you stack up against your friends!  

Custom Tracks and Cruise Mode

Feeling creative?  Build a custom track!  Just chilling?  Cruise without traffic and unlimited upgrades!

WISHLIST ALL GAS NOW!

In this Game, you will be able to enjoy massive robot laser battles in a future dominated by robots where all that is left is ALL OUT WAR!

You design the army. The army fights the war.

Here, you don't control the units. They act autonomously. Capturing command points, upgrading your base, shooting at the enemy ,all of that. Your job is to select which units will go to battle and how many. 

Build the legion

Will you choose a massive army of cheap pawns? Or will you choose a small elite army of the strongest robots in the galaxy? 

Many of different unit types and roles: frontline troopers, ranged hunters, heavy weapons, indirect-fire support, melee specialists, builders, and more.

Pick your battlefield

Tile-based maps with full per-map environments: open plains, dense forests, Snow plains. Terrain shapes how your units flow across the field in large armies of hundreds of units

Watch it play out

Hundreds of autonomous units engage across a battlefield. Enjoy the massive battles from the comfort of your retrofuturistic / Scifi / CRT TV! You choose what the next wave of units will be, and watch them go. 

A retro-futuristic look

It's a relaxing approach to RTS, where the fun is in watching the battle unfold while experimenting many different types of strategies. Cassete-Punk to it's core!

Mahjong with nothing hidden

In ALL-HU you see the whole table — every hand, the discards, the entire wall. Victory demands more than one win: plan draws, discards and yaku so that two, or even four, hands each reach a winning "Hu" in a single flawless sequence. One wrong discard early can strand the last hand twenty moves later.

What's inside

  • Story mode — 11 chapters told in ink-wash vignettes, from your first night at the table to the final board.
  • Free mode — 200 puzzles that climb from gentle warm-ups to four-hand brain-benders.
  • Challenge mode — a 550+ puzzle gauntlet with special rule twists, punctuated by Zhenlong set-piece boards.
  • Gambit — Steam exclusive. 300 set-piece boards where every hand must win with the same yaku — the hardest mode in the game.
  • Mahjong basics — a 17-lesson interactive course. Never played mahjong? Start here; the game teaches you everything from reading tiles to scoring.

Fair by construction

Every single puzzle is verified solvable by the game's own solver before it ships. Stuck anyway? Hints, full step-by-step solutions and tenpai checks are all unlimited — learn at your own pace.

One purchase, everything

No in-app purchases, no energy systems. The Steam edition includes all content and all assists, permanently.

Interface in 9 languages: English, 繁體中文, 简体中文, 日本語, 한국어, Español, Français, Deutsch, Português (Brasil).
Play with keyboard and mouse, or with a controller (partial controller support).

I wanted to make a game where players just kill each other. Fast, bloody, no long setup.

It started with the deathmatches in Nox, the old Westwood game from 2000. Small arena, a few people, spells and swords flying everywhere, someone always dying in some stupid way. AMEN: MAYHEM is my take on that, with pixel art and a lot more blood.

Up to 12 players per match. Bots fill the empty slots, so you can jump in right away. Official servers are built in, no extra account needed. When someone dies, their gear drops and anyone can grab it.

There's a lot of gore. Heads and limbs come off. You can tone it down or turn it off in the settings.

My friends helped a lot with the multiplayer. Server work is my day job, so I was able to set up and run the official servers myself. Any feedback on the Steam forums really helps.

Gold safe: hit the 1 kg jackpot

Crack open a gold safe and watch gold bars, coins and cash spill out – with a bit of luck, a bar of up to 1 kg drops out.

Silver safe: stacks of silver bars

A silver safe pours out gleaming silver bars and banknotes – click each piece to scoop it up.

Iron safe: cold hard cash

Even the humble iron safe pays off: it pops open with bundles of banknotes ready to grab.

American Life Simulator

Build your American dream from the ground up.

Welcome to a peaceful American neighborhood where every job is a new opportunity. Start with simple lawn mowing, hedge trimming, street cleaning, garbage collection, and other everyday neighborhood tasks to earn money and build your future.

Mow every lawn on the block

Climb onto your lawn tractor, drop the blades and turn overgrown yards into clean, even stripes. Keep an eye on the fuel gauge, refill at the pump and get paid for every lawn you finish.

Leave it better than you found it

Tall grass in, perfect stripes out. Pass after pass, the whole neighborhood starts to look like a postcard.

Trim the hedges

Rent an electric chainsaw from the market and shape every overgrown bush on the street. Leaves fly, cash comes in.

Sweep the streets

Take the wheel of the street sweeper and clear the trash and leaves from every road in the neighborhood.

Take out the trash

Collect the black garbage bags left around the neighborhood, load up your cart and haul them to the recycling containers. Every bag pays.

Run it all from your tablet

Open your in-game tablet to buy and rent equipment from the market, check your bank account, track income and expenses, and read up on every neighbor.

Buy the house. Then the next one.

Save your earnings, purchase your first home, expand your property portfolio, and collect rental income from tenants. As your wealth grows, unlock new tools, vehicles, and opportunities while transforming from an ordinary worker into one of the richest real estate owners in town.

Explore a relaxing open neighborhood, improve your skills, manage your finances, and experience the satisfaction of creating your own version of the American Dream.

Features

  • 🌿 Complete a variety of neighborhood jobs.

  • 🏡 Buy houses and expand your real estate empire.

  • 💰 Earn passive rental income from your properties.

  • 🚗 Unlock better equipment and vehicles.

  • 🌳 Explore a peaceful American suburban neighborhood.

  • 📈 Grow your wealth and become a real estate millionaire.

  • 🎮 Relaxing progression with satisfying gameplay.

Will you stay a hardworking neighbor, or will you buy the entire neighborhood?

Run the Cable deeper

There is no light at the bottom of the Chasm.
You have a headlamp, and the Cable spooling out behind you. That is all.

While you stay connected, the Cable heals you and lights the ground around you.
Cut loose from it, and the dark closes in — and so does the Chasm's Corruption.

Running the Cable further costs Fluid Animite. You get that from the things you kill.

Exploration and combat are the same ground

Exploration runs in real time.
The moment something spots you, it becomes a turn-based fight right where you stand.
Where you happened to be standing when it started can decide the whole thing — position matters that much.

So look before you commit. How many are there? Can your current Equipment actually take them?

Put the Elemental Fields to work

Run electricity into a Soaked floor or a pond and the Shocked state spreads across the entire surface. hit an oil-soaked enemy with fire and it burns.

Four elements — fire, water, electricity, oil. Learn the Elemental Reactions they make together, and combat opens up all at once.

Every enemy demands an answer.

Nothing down there goes down easily, but once you understand what an enemy does, that knowledge is your opening.

A living ecosystem thrives within the Chasm.

When you witness enemies preying on or clashing with each other along the food chain, whether you slip past unnoticed or step in to reap the spoils is entirely up to you.

Monsters that grow strong lay eggs and multiply. The balance of the ecosystem is always shifting.

Go deep for the rare finds. Then all you have to do is get back out.

The best material is at the bottom.

Some unique tools hidden below will completely transform your playstyle.

Get out of the Chasm before time runs out

When you call for extraction, the ecosystem you've been meddling with is what comes for you.
On every floor, decide which creatures to let live and which to deal with - with that final escape already in mind.

Hold out against the onslaught until the Extraction Winch comes down, and you're as good as home.

Apartment 001 is a horror, puzzle, and mystery adventure game.


You awaken inside an unknown facility and must explore its mysterious spaces in order to recover your lost memories. Gather clues, follow the records and procedures left behind by the Bureau, and overcome the threatening anomalies that stand in your way.

Welcome, Bureau Personnel.


The Bureau is an organization dedicated to controlling and managing anomalies in order to protect everyone, including you, from the threats they pose.


However, due to an unknown incident, the Bureau has lost control of its anomalies.


Uncontained anomalies now exist throughout the facility, and it is your duty to explore the area and uncover the truth behind the incident.


Anomalies


Anything can become an anomaly. Moving mannequins, places where unidentified creatures appear, and phenomena that defy understanding.


Anomalies vary greatly in form and level of danger.


If you encounter an anomaly, be sure to read the containment procedures written by the Bureau. As long as you follow the proper protocols, you may be able to bring the anomaly under control.


Who knows? There may even be an anomaly that becomes your friend.


Features


  • A first-person exploration game combining horror, puzzles, and mystery adventure
  • Uncover the secrets of the facility through clues and documents
  • Solve puzzles by following anomaly containment procedures
  • Trace the truth behind your lost memories and the Bureau
  • Encounter strange and threatening anomalies


Do you agree to comply with all of the above?


Then the protocol will begin shortly...

Race down a water slide with up to 8 players! Dive straight into the pool at the finish!

Slide and Compete

The rules are simple. Just race down a massive water slide with 8 players at once.

But with everyone pushing and crashing, it's pure chaos. The order you dive into the pool decides everything.

Break Out of the Course

Sliding straight isn't always the right answer.

Leap over the walls and fly off the course for a straight shot to the finish!

Nail it for a huge comeback, miss it for a huge fall.

Chaos with 8, Fun on Your Own

Play with friends, or match up with players from around the world.

Want to play right now but nobody's around? Bot matches have you covered.

Courses and Characters, Endlessly Varied

A wide variety of courses with completely different gimmicks and terrain.

Collect gems to freely customize your character's look.

[Videos & Streaming]

Gameplay videos and streams are welcome! Please check the following two points:

1. Include the game's name in the title. (Required)

2. Include the Steam store page URL in the description. (Optional)

Archive Zero is a narrative investigation and management game set in an alternate 1960s Britain during the Cold War.

You work behind a desk, sorting through reports, photographs, letters, artifacts, and other material that is sent to the archive. Most of it looks ordinary at first. Some of it is not.

Read carefully, compare information across cases, and decide what deserves your attention. As more files arrive, connections begin to appear between people, places, and events that were never meant to be connected.

Between investigations, you will manage resources, upgrades, and the growing demands of the archive itself.

FEATURES

  • Examine classified documents, photographs, artifacts, and field records.

  • Follow cases that range from routine incidents to much larger investigations.

  • Connect information across separate files and events.

  • Manage resources and archive upgrades.

  • Discover hidden cases and material.

  • Collect photographs, postcards, stamps, cigarette cards, artifacts, and other archival items.

  • Make choices about what to pursue and what to leave alone.

Sometimes the most important thing in a file is what is not written down.

Step into the role of an archive worker and bring order back to a room full of misplaced documents. Open boxes, carry stacks of files, sort them by the archive’s rules, and return every file to its proper place on the shelves.


This is a first-person organizing simulator focused on calm, satisfying work. Learn how each shelf is arranged, keep categories in order, and place documents in the right sequence to restore the archive one section at a time.

Sandbox Mode

In Sandbox Mode, you choose a level from the available selection and receive a series of archive-related tasks. To complete the level and earn rewards, you need to process a large number of incoming documents and place them correctly on the shelves. Some documents are already stored in boxes, while others must be found scattered throughout the location. Before starting, you receive work instructions that may vary from level to level.
Some tasks require sorting documents by date, others by number or category, while more complex levels may require you to organize files using several parameters at once.
As you work, you can track your progress and periodically receive rewards for completing parts of the job. These rewards come in the form of additional perks that can speed up or simplify the process — such as faster searching, quicker document placement, automatic sorting, and other optional improvements that support your preferred playstyle.

Campaign Mode

In Campaign Mode, you go through a series of short sessions structured around working days. Each day introduces new tasks and archive assignments. You will sort incoming documents, find and submit requested files, check and edit records, clean up the workspace, fix mistakes made by other employees, and complete other archive-related tasks.

Features

  • Sort, carry, and shelve documents in a first-person archive workspace.
  • Organize files by category, subcategory, and date as you bring order to the shelves.
  • Take documents from boxes, move them by hand, and place them where they belong.
  • Reorganize shelf rows and improve the layout as the archive slowly comes together.
  • Handle special document requests while continuing your daily sorting work.
  • Enjoy the satisfaction of turning a cluttered archive into a neat, orderly system.
  • Whether you want to relax and tidy up at your own pace or work efficiently to restore order faster, the archive is waiting.

An indie action RPG set in a fantasy world. Experience a deep storyline and immersive action featuring beautiful characters and environments!

Worldview & Story

The story begins when the Archscroll created by an ancient archmage disappears.

The player must find the Archscroll and embark on their adventure. 

While uncovering what the Archscroll really is and why it disappeared, various incidents unfold.

Players will travel through various regions of the world, staying there and engaging in battle.

Players can choose a class before embarking on their adventure.

Free Class Change System

Players can change their class at any time while in town. All classes share levels, stat points, and ability points.

Each class features a unique combat style.

  • Knight - Delivers heavy-hitting combat clad in heavy armor, wielding a two-handed sword.

  • Mercenary - Specializes in fast-paced combat, clad in leather armor and wielding a single-handed sword.

  • Wizard - Ranged magic combat, clad in a robe and wielding a staff.

Weapon Aura Attacks

All classes can use a Weapon Aura that infuses weapons with mana.

Parry Attacks

Players can perform a parry attack during battle.

Depending on the enemy's strength, timing a normal or special attack perfectly will interrupt the enemy and leave them vulnerable.

Various Status Effects

Players can inflict status effects on enemies during battle, such as stun or reduced movement speed.

Players can gain experience and level up by defeating enemies in combat and completing quests.

Upon leveling up, they will earn Stat Points and Ability Points.

Ability & Talent Enhancement

Abilities include Normal Ability, Special Ability, and Talent.

Players can upgrade stats, special abilities, and talents while staying in town after leveling up.

Items & Equipment

Players can purchase equippable and consumable items from weapon, armor, or general stores to use in battle.

Custom Control Configuration

Players can fully customize their keybindings and controller layouts to suit their playstyle.

Auto-Save Support

Players can quit at any time during battle, and their progress will be auto-saved upon departure.

A visual novel with English voices where the world is dying, the cat is a live AI god, and the captain is dangerously oblivious to her own past...

Controls

Play with only a mouse, only a keyboard, or both. A controller is optional (partial controller support). The in-game keyboard lets mouse users enter written answers using Latin, accented Latin and Cyrillic characters.

ASANA Visual Novel is a sci-fi dark comedy visual novel where your choices shape your character, your stats shape your options, and N.E.K.O., the ship's godlike AI, currently in cat form, permanently in judgment mode, watches everything and is not impressed.

You are Captain Asana. Planets keep exploding in your rearview mirror, heavily armed Cat-Ptain Paradox is getting too close too fast, and nobody will tell you why. Build your character. Make your choices. Try not to make things worse.

Things will go wrong. They always do. Whether you fix them, survive them, or fail spectacularly depends on you. And yes, you can let the world rot if that's who you are.

And in selected story scenes, you can talk to N.E.K.O. in your own words. AI generates his replies within the scene and the character's role. Conversations and challenges have rules and limits. He has opinions. You will not enjoy all of them.

🐱 Features

* 🎛️ Stat-based character creation: Captain, Explorer, Pilot, Charm, and a hidden fifth skill (good luck finding it)

* 🌌 Branching routes through the crisis: your stats open and close doors you didn't know existed

* 🤖 Live AI conversations: talk to N.E.K.O. in selected scenes, with replies generated through Anthropic Claude within the game's rules

* 🎯 AI conversation challenges: write your own response, follow the challenge's rules, and try to talk your way out of trouble...

* 📖 A story planned across eight chapters: branching routes, new challenges, and escalating cosmic chaos

* 🔁 Replay value: different stats, different routes, different outcomes, and AI responses that can vary

* 🎨 Hand-drawn concepts, handcrafted story: set in the established ASANA webcomic universe

* 🛠️ Solo dev, first game. Built with love, sweat, and Ren'Py. No, it will not do your dishes or clean your room!

* 🎙️ English voices: prerecorded dialogue, with optional English speech through ElevenLabs for selected AI replies

Online features and offline play

Live AI conversations and challenges require Internet, as does generating new speech. You can turn online AI off. When online services are unavailable or disabled, the story continues with text and built-in offline responses.

Online features include up to 200 AI requests to use across chats and minigames, plus 50 English voice-generation requests per installation. These allowances are shared across playthroughs. When a limit is reached, the game remains playable using text and built-in offline alternatives. Prerecorded voices and already-generated cached audio remain available.

🚀 Wishlist now

 N.E.K.O. is waiting.

WISHGATE-A49BX4WB

Internet connection required. ASTERIS is always online, including solo play: your characters, gear and progress are saved on our servers.

Thousands of builds. MMO-style progression.

33 active skills, each reshaped 24 ways. Five gods, each with its own form and ultimate. Rifts that never end.

Forge your own build solo. Bring down colossal bosses together.

ASTERIS is a 1–4 player action roguelite that combines roguelite buildcraft with MMO-style co-op raids. Reshape your chosen skills into entirely different techniques and take on the forms of five gods to turn the battle. Your gear and growth survive each run, becoming the strength behind your next challenge.

THE SAME HERO. A WHOLE NEW WAY TO FIGHT.

A slash becomes a dash, splits into three attacks, or unleashes a shadow clone.

Reshape each of the 33 active skills across four heroes in 24 ways. Combine 50+ passives, transform techniques with runes, or choose the path toward True Name awakenings.

The skills you choose matter. How you complete them matters just as much.

TURN THE TIDE. TAKE A GOD'S FORM.

Sweep through enemies with fire. Strike with the storm. Consume them with the void.

Take on the forms of five gods and let divine power flow through your skills. Each god brings distinct powers and a signature ultimate. Turn a moment of danger into your chance to strike back.

YOUR FRIEND'S ULTIMATE IS YOUR CUE.

When one player unleashes a god's ultimate, join with your own. DIVINE RESONANCE sends a blast out from each resonating hero and strengthens their damage until their transformation ends. Four distinct builds become one decisive moment of power.

A TANK WHO HOLDS. DAMAGE THAT HITS. A HEALER WHO KEEPS YOU FIGHTING.

Dodge the telegraphs, cleanse curses and pull enemies off your allies. When everyone plays their role, your party can break through fights that damage alone could not win.

Test your build solo, or invite Steam friends to the Asterian Deep, a raid dungeon with six bosses. Azhdarak, the Last Dragon, awaits at the end.

No party yet? Quick Match finds you one with a single click.

THE RUN ENDS. THE STRENGTH YOU EARN STAYS.

Gather loot, enhance your gear and push into higher difficulties. Collect appearances to make your hero your own, and find the equipment you need in the player marketplace.

The progress you earn in this challenge becomes the starting point for your next.

ENDLESS RIFTS. EPIC GEAR.

Master a stage and its Rift opens: new monsters, new mid-bosses and new patterns for the boss you thought you knew. Rift levels never end, each level brings its own mutation, and epic gear drops only in the Rift.

Rifts are open for Stages 1–3, with more on the way.

FOUR HEROES. FOUR WAYS TO FIGHT.

  • Dark Slayer — Melee damage built on timing: blade dashes, chains and eclipse executions. Tank or damage.
  • Vanguard — A tank with golden gauntlets who splits the ground open. Tank or damage.
  • Windrunner — Arrows that strike and heal, cyclones and storms of arrows. Damage or healer.
  • Aether — Support powered by a star core: shields, relics and supernovas. Damage or healer.

MORE BATTLEFIELDS AHEAD

  • November — Out now: Collection, Rifts for Stages 1–3, Quick Match, Skill Chains and fixes from your feedback
  • December — Major free winter update: new stage, new dungeon and balance improvements
  • January — New hero
  • February — New item categories

Forge your build. Gather your party.

Before humanity arrives, everything must be ready

An unmanned construction system has been deployed to a distant planet.

Its mission is simple:

Build a settlement capable of supporting human life before the colony ship arrives.

Mine raw materials, manufacture structural components, purify water, generate oxygen, process CO2 and wastewater, and establish supply links with remote sectors.

But a base that merely functions is not enough.

Power demand will rise. Machines will overheat. Defective products will appear. Logistics will stall. Life-support loads will fluctuate. External connections will become unstable.

Design a base with enough capacity, redundancy, and resilience to keep running under pressure.

Build and expand automated production lines

Place facilities on a grid and connect them with conveyor belts to create functioning production chains.

As the campaign progresses, your base will grow from a simple material-processing site into a fully integrated settlement network.

  • Mine ore and produce structural plates

  • Manufacture insulation and habitat panels

  • Inspect finished products and remove defects

  • Purify ice into clean water

  • Generate oxygen through electrolysis

  • Process CO2 and wastewater

  • Import dense ore from remote sectors

  • Coordinate every system through settlement control

Success depends on more than raw production speed.

You must balance power, heat, throughput, storage, quality, and supply margins across the entire base.

From a working base to a resilient one

Each phase introduces a series of certifications that test whether your base is truly ready to advance.

During certification, the simulation applies predefined stresses such as:

  • Increased power demand

  • Higher residential consumption

  • Link instability

  • CO2 spikes

  • Import delays

  • Sustained full-system load

These events are deterministic rather than random.

When something fails, you can identify the cause, redesign the layout, expand capacity, and try again with a better plan.

Certifications can be paused or accelerated, allowing you to inspect problems carefully or fast-forward once the base is stable.

Manage power, heat, and quality

Every machine consumes power, and some facilities generate heat while operating.

Expand too aggressively and the grid may collapse.
Neglect cooling and production equipment may shut down.
Ignore quality control and defective products may enter the supply chain.

A base built at its absolute limit may work under normal conditions, but it will not survive certification.

Plan for spare capacity. Add cooling. Build backup power. Use buffers. Create redundant production lines.

Create a complete life-support cycle

ASTERSTEAD is not only about manufacturing.

The base must also support human life.

Mine ice, purify it into clean water, split water into oxygen, and supply habitat modules. Process the CO2 and wastewater they produce to keep the system stable.

Every major system contributes to settlement readiness.

In the final phase, the overall score is determined by the weakest part of the base.

One failing system can hold everything back.

Expand beyond the base

Survey remote sectors and establish links to off-site resources.

Different sectors offer different levels of risk and efficiency.

Safer sectors provide stable supply.
Higher-risk sectors offer greater output but place more stress on the link network.

Use import ports, buffers, remote miners, and link stabilizers to create a reliable external supply chain.

Take on the Grand Runs

Each phase ends with a long-form integrated certification called a Grand Run.

Grand Runs combine the systems introduced so far and test whether your base can remain stable over an extended period.

The final Grand Run is the ultimate settlement inspection.

When production, life support, logistics, power, and external supply all meet the required standard, the base will finally be cleared to receive its first colonists.

Build freely in Sandbox Mode

Sandbox Mode unlocks every facility and decoration from the beginning.

Construction is free, and additional tools let you modify or disable selected simulation systems.

Use it to:

  • Build large-scale bases

  • Test production layouts

  • Trigger stress events manually

  • Load sample bases

  • Adjust resources and system rules

  • Create decorative layouts

  • Hide the HUD for screenshots

The simulation remains fully active by default, so power, heat, quality, logistics, and life support still behave normally unless you choose to disable them.

Key Features

  • Top-down automation and base-building gameplay

  • A single persistent base that expands throughout the campaign

  • Production chains built from mining, transport, processing, inspection, and storage

  • Power shortages, heat buildup, defective products, and logistics congestion

  • Clean water, oxygen, CO2, and wastewater life-support systems

  • Remote sector exploration and resource imports

  • Deterministic, repeatable stress tests instead of random disasters

  • Pause and fast-forward controls during certifications

  • Multi-phase progression culminating in the Grand Run

  • A fully featured Sandbox Mode

  • Decorative facilities and floor markings with no gameplay effect

  • No combat and no reflex-based gameplay

  • A focus on planning, diagnosis, optimization, and long-term stability

AT THE READY is a third-person Wild West quick-draw game about the few tense seconds before a shot. Watch your rival, wait for the real signal, then draw, aim and fire. Move too soon and you foul; hesitate and you may be the one who falls.

DUEL YOUR WAY



  • Face another gunslinger in 1v1 duels, or enter a three-player last-gunslinger-standing standoff.
  • Play online with Steam friends or join a room with its six-digit code. The host can switch duel modes in the lobby, and players can choose an open seat.
  • Practice alone against a quick-drawing computer opponent. Fake draws add another layer of bluffing before the signal.

CALL THE SHOTS



Take the optional Signal Caller seat: watch from gunslinger or panoramic viewpoints, send decoy calls and decide when to call the real Fire signal. With no human caller, the game handles the signal. Human-called matches keep their results but do not count toward the fastest-time leaderboard.

EVERY SHOWDOWN HAS A TWIST



Rule Roulette changes the conditions with twists such as headshots only, a quiet signal or unsteady aim.

OUTSMART YOUR RIVAL



Choose a skill card before the draw to change your approach.

CHASE YOUR FASTEST DRAW



  • In Shadow Challenge, your first winning hit creates your own Shadow from your draw timing, aim path and shot. Beat it to replace your personal best, then face the stronger Shadow next round.
  • Compare fastest times on Steam friends and global leaderboards. Where a Shadow record is available, challenge that player's recorded duel directly from the leaderboard. Shadow Challenge uses the standard duel rules.

The shot that decides the match gets a brief cinematic camera moment.


Fight in a stylized low-poly Western town where reflexes, timing and nerve matter as much as raw speed.

The frequency is yours.

08:40 in Palma. A thunderstorm is building over the final approach, the wind has just shifted, three arrivals are waiting for vectors and a departure reports an engine failure on the takeoff roll. Nobody is coming to help. You are the controller.

ATC: Tower & Ground is an air traffic control simulator built from real Spanish aeronautical data, where every instruction you give has a consequence you can see on the radar.

THE WEATHER IS NOT DECORATION

Live METAR. Winds in layers that push aircraft off the centreline. Thunderstorm cells crawling across the weather radar, windshear on short final, fog that drops visibility below minimums and sends traffic to the alternate. The wind decides which runway is in use, and it can turn the whole airport around in the middle of your shift.

AIRCRAFT THAT FLY LIKE AIRCRAFT

An A380 does not turn like an ATR. Every type has its own climb, descent, speed limits and wake category. Put a light aircraft too close behind a heavy and the pilot will go around. Ask for something the aircraft cannot do and the pilot will tell you: unable.

PILOTS THAT TALK BACK

Real ICAO phraseology. Readbacks, requests, and a reminder when you forget a handoff. Pilots fly their published procedures, and they expect you to know them too.

WHEN IT GOES WRONG

Engine failures on the takeoff roll. Fuel emergencies. Bird strikes on final. Medical cases, brake failures, unruly passengers. Fire trucks, ambulances and police roll across the airfield, runways close, and if an aircraft goes down, a SAR helicopter is waiting for your call. Every emergency has its own procedure, and the clock is running.

TWO POSITIONS

Approach · Tower: vector arrivals onto the ILS, build the sequence, run the holdings and the missed approaches, and hand every aircraft to Tower and Centre yourself.

Ground · Tower: IFR clearances with the right SID and squawk, pushbacks, taxi routes through the real taxiways, runway crossings and takeoff clearances.

REAL DATA. NO SHORTCUTS.

Runways, taxiways, stands, SIDs, STARs, ILS approaches, minimum radar altitudes and restricted areas, recreated from public aeronautical publications. Controllers who work these frequencies for real have tested the game since the first build. If you have flown into these airports, you will recognise them.

ALL OF SPAIN, ONE AIRPORT AT A TIME

The goal is to cover Spanish airspace. Palma, Ibiza, Menorca and Barcelona are already in, with a Multi-tower mode that runs the Balearic airports on a single radar. The next airports will be chosen with the community.

FEATURES

  • Approach · Tower and Ground · Tower positions
  • Dynamic weather: METAR, layered winds, storms, windshear and low visibility
  • Real SIDs, STARs, ILS approaches, holdings, MRVA sectors and restricted areas
  • Per-type aircraft performance and wake turbulence separation
  • Emergencies with fire, medical, police and SAR services
  • Manual handoffs, single runway operations and diversions
  • Three difficulty levels: Cadet, Operator and Supervisor
  • Interactive tutorials, Steam Achievements and Steam Cloud
  • Full interface in English, Spanish and Catalan

Coming in Early Access: pilot voices on the radio, voice control for your own instructions (beta) and more Spanish airports.

ATTAQ ARCADE COLLECTION

A collection of complete, punchy games packed inside a tactile desktop launcher.

You start at an old computer, with floppy disks scattered across the table. Pick one up, drag it into the drive, and boot the game. A tiny ritual before jumping into another world.

The collection currently includes:

1. Blood Rewind

Estimated playtime: 50-90 min.

The flagship game of the collection.

A fast, addictive pixel roguelike where every new run makes you stronger. Smash through waves of enemies, collect upgrades, unlock helper drones, grab heavier weapons, and slowly turn your character into an unstoppable storm of bullets, blood, and effects.

Easy to start. Hard to stop.

2. Type Type Teo

Estimated playtime: 65-95 min.

A typing trainer wrapped in a hacker game.

You are the operator of a squad breaking into networks node by node. To move forward, you have to type fast and stay focused.

The texts you type come from all over the internet: forum posts, private messages, logs, hidden corners of the web. At first it feels almost normal. Then the messages start getting darker.

3. Glitch Racers

Estimated playtime: 25-60 min.

Classic arcade racing with a glitchy soul.

Race, overtake, shoot, crash, restart, beat your own time, and try to stay ahead. Simple, fast, and very easy to replay.

And yes – you can play it with a friend on the same PC in local two-player mode.

4. Zen Signal

Estimated playtime: 30-40 min.

A relaxing clicker about catching signals from space.

Upgrade your equipment, listen through the noise, and discover disturbing messages from the crew of a missing space expedition. It starts calm, almost meditative, but the deeper you go, the more uncomfortable the silence becomes.

More floppy disks will be added over time.

New games, alternate versions, strange experiments, and hidden little surprises – all thrown onto the same dusty table. ATTAQ Arcade Collection is meant to grow like a box of games you found somewhere and decided to keep.

Abductables is an incremental roguelite where you pilot a flying saucer and pull humans off the ground with your tractor beam. Stack as many as you can into one abduction, convert them into alien human hybrids, and cash in for big combo payouts. Every run earns you money to spend on permanent upgrades, so each attempt sends a stronger saucer back down to Earth. Watch your ship’s power, refuel by turning biomass into energy, and use your stealth ability to slip past an armed response that grows as time goes on.

Capture Multiple Humans For Big Payouts

Don’t settle for one at a time. Hold your beam over a crowd and lift as many humans as you can at once. The bigger the stack you bring in, the bigger the combo when they’re converted into hybrids, and the more you have to spend on your next upgrade.

Avoid The Armed Response

The longer you stay, the harder the humans hit back. The armed response escalates as your run goes on and fills the sky with fire. Weave through it, use Field Kits to neutralize the threat or use your stealth ability to slip out of sight until the heat dies down.

Use Upgrades To Capture Even More Humans

This is where the incremental loop kicks in. Spend what you earn on upgrades that you keep between runs. Lift more humans per pull, hold more power, and push your combos higher. Runs that once ended in seconds turn into massive abduction sprees.

Refill Ship Power With The Biomass Tractor Beam

Everything your saucer does drains power, but running dry no longer ends the run. Your saucer slows down and switches to the biomass tractor beam, and stealth, Field Kits and specials stay locked until you refuel. Pull up biomass to convert it straight into energy and everything unlocks again. Knowing when to stop abducting and refuel is the key to longer runs and bigger earnings.

Sign New Orders Every Milestone

Survive long enough and the Grigori Group sends a memo. Pick one of three Directives, each a new rule for the rest of the act that stacks on top of your usual abductions. Take the order that fits your run and ignore the rest.

Recall Legacy Stock For Double Payouts

Under the Legacy Recall Directive, cryptids appear near town under a magenta light. Hunt one down and beam it aboard with a crowd, and that whole batch pays double. Wait too long and it slips back into the woods. This is just an example of one of the directives to choose from.

Win by emptying your hand.

Abjure is a roguelike deckbuilder built on Big 2, the shedding card game played across Asia and beyond. Beat what’s on the table or pass. First to run out of cards wins. Learn it in minutes, then spend dozens of runs learning how far the rules can bend.

Break the rules of Big 2

57 relics rewrite the game you thought you knew. Straights that skip ranks. Flushes with an off-suit card. Five of a Kind. A Quad that bombs a Straight Flush. Every relic belongs to a build (Flush, Sets, Straight, Tempo, Control or Economy), and the shop shows which ones fit what you already hold.

How a run works

  • Split your deck into piles and pick the ones you take into each fight

  • Play higher than your opponent, or pass. Empty your hand first to win

  • Earn gold. Win clean and never pass for more. Save it to earn interest, or borrow from the Loan Shark

  • Spend it on cards, relics, removals, reveals and one-shot gambits

  • Take the crossroads instead of a fight: a three-way choice that can reshape your deck

  • A boss ends every level, and some are built to counter exactly the build you’re running

  • Lose a regular fight and you burn a Chip. Lose a boss fight, or run out of Chips, and the run is over

Hands Big 2 never had

Stack a deck toward pairs and triples, spread it into long straights, or dye it into one suit. Build far enough and you’ll play hands that don’t exist in the original game.

Six characters

  • Clairvoyant: sees half the piles, and half the opponent’s hand

  • Picky: throws away a card before each fight

  • Dupe: copies a card before each fight

  • Switcheroo: never just passes. Draws, or swaps hands

  • Greedy: fewer cards, more gold

  • Duelist: answer one rank higher and shed an extra card

Keep coming back

  • 14 starting decks, from 26 to 104 cards

  • 20 prestige levels per character

  • 24 boss modifiers, 19 crossroads events, elite fights

  • Win the run, then press on into The Reckoning for score

  • Daily Challenge: one seeded run for everyone, one attempt

  • Shareable seeds, achievements, and a collection to fill

Also included

  • Classic Big 2 with no roguelike layer, for when you just want the cards

  • A guided tutorial if you’ve never played Big 2

  • Full controller and Steam Deck support

  • 20 languages, including Traditional and Simplified Chinese, Japanese, Korean, Vietnamese and Thai

Abjure is in active development by a solo developer. Wishlist now to be notified and follow along through Early Access.

Abyss Card Legends: A quirky, single-class side-scrolling RPG with absolute solo-farming thrills!

Still taking turns playing cards in traditional, boring grid layouts? It's time to break the monotony! Welcome to the fantasy world of Abyss Card Legends—where cards aren't just pieces of paper, but powerful heroes crashing straight into battle!

Core Features: Side-Scrolling Real-Time Clashes—The Tide of War Shifts in a Flash

Say goodbye to dull turn-based gameplay and experience the most intuitive real-time combat. In a side-scrolling arena, your cards transform into characters, clashing in fierce, exhilarating battles.

  • Master the Rhythm: Observe the battlefield and unleash core skills at the perfect moment.

  • Perfect Your Positioning: Shift your formations to maximize your damage output.

  • Conquer the Stages: Diverse themed game environments are waiting for your challenge.

Pure MMO Progression—Say Goodbye to the "Grinding" Burden

Abyss Card Legends retains the most addictive joy of traditional MMO progression while completely stripping away those exhausting modern net-game chores:

  • ❌ No Paywalls: Zero forced monetization traps. Every piece of gear and every item can be earned purely through gameplay!

  • ❌ No Brain-Drain: Pure, simple joy. All Bosses are available to fight anytime, and all top-tier rewards belong 100% to you!

  • ❌ No Toxic Competition: Say goodbye to toxic players camp-killing or stealing spots. Enjoy the purest joy of adventure in a safe, single-player open world!

Traverse the Multiverse Abyss—Build Your Ultimate Hero

As you level up, more powerful skills will unlock. Collect sacrifice gear, enhance your character through endless looting, and rise to the absolute top!

You will journey alone through abyss stages of vastly different styles, facing quirky enemies and Bosses with highly unique mechanics.

This is a casual, humorous, yet highly challenging single-player adventure. How far your hero can go depends entirely on your wisdom and strategy!

The gates of the Abyss are open. Your legend officially begins now!!!

ONE BUTTON. ENDLESS CHAOS.

AbyssMachine is a fast-paced action roguelite where a simple press can start a devastating chain reaction. Push forward through escalating stages, build a run around unpredictable card combinations, and turn every throw into something bigger, stranger, and more destructive.

BUILD THE CHAIN REACTION

Choose cards that change the rules of your run. Bounce attacks across the field, split your throws, amplify their size, trigger unexpected abilities, and discover combinations that transform a single action into total chaos. No two builds need to play the same way. Chase a focused strategy, improvise around rare finds, or take a risky path for a bigger payoff.

SURVIVE THE ESCALATION

The further you go, the more dangerous the world becomes. Face growing enemy pressure, hostile environments, elite encounters, and powerful bosses as you push for higher stages. Build carefully. Adapt quickly. Press the button one more time.

Game Features

  •  Discover a variety of fun items, objects, turrets, throwable objects, traps, and obstacles to create your own way to play.

  • Choose from hundreds of cards to shape your build and decide how you want to progress. Strengthen yourself, or empower your enemies to make the game even more challenging.

  • Multiple playable characters, each with their own unique set of cards.

  • Use the environment, terrain, and elemental reactions to defeat enemies and BOSSes.

  • Unpredictable environmental events, enemies from different factions, and chaotic battles can erupt at any moment.

Welcome to Abyssal Hollow!

Abyssal Hollow is a creepy-cute alchemy idle game where every seed has a fate. Grow mysterious plants in your dark little lab, then harvest them for potion ingredients or bring them into the Abyss as living companions who can attack, shield, heal, and keep you alive.

Venture into cursed depths to battle eerie creatures, collect rare equipment, gather gold, and discover new seeds to grow back home. Just do not ignore your garden for too long. Neglected plants may mutate, wither, or return as vengeful spirits that haunt your future runs!

Experiment with potions, unlock upgrades, expand your laboratory, and build a haunted garden that grows stronger with every descent. Cute things dwell in the dark too.

The Cauldron Always Answers

Drop in whatever you have, stir bravely, and watch the cauldron cough up a potion. Some brews heal, some help, and some should probably be labeled with a tiny skull.

Brew carefully. The right potion can keep you alive, power up your monsters, or crush a boss. The wrong one can make the dungeon much, much happier to see you. The potions you bring on a run can be as just as key to your survival as your character build.

From Seeds to Sidekicks

Battle creatures in the Abyss to collect mysterious seeds, then plant them in your haunted garden to grow adorable monster companions. Raise your little horrors, bring them into dungeon combat, and build a stronger team with every run.

Treat your little horrors with care. Neglect them, and they may turn against you. Let them die, and their restless spirits may haunt your future runs through the Abyss.

Dungeon Combat

We put a fresh little twist on classic idle combat.

Your companion creatures handle the steady fighting on their own, while you jump in with active, cooldown-based skills that shape the battle. Magic skills are your heavy hitters, but they require careful mana management. Melee skills are weaker, but always reliable when your mana runs dry.

You can also support your tiny monsters with buffs, debuff enemies, and use crowd control to keep the Abyss from chewing everyone into decorative confetti.

Features

  • Plant and grow strange creature-like seeds in your alchemy lab

  • Harvest plants to brew potions and strengthen future runs

  • Bring grown plants into the Abyss as helpful battle companions

  • Battle cursed creatures and collect gold, equipment, and rare seeds

  • Spend gold at the equipment shop for upgrades

  • Try your luck at the Wishing Maw for a chance at cursed or legendary equipment

  • Upgrade your lab, unlock new skills, and expand your growing power

  • Push deeper with every run as enemies grow stronger, demanding better builds, and smarter use of your skills.

Discover a creepy-cute world of soft monsters, dark magic, and alchemical weirdness

In Development

  • 24 Levels and Floor Bosses

  • 144 Items to Equip

  • 28 Companion Plant Creatures

  • 784 Potions to Brew

  • 27 Skills to Unlock

  • Planned Post Release: Crossbreed Your Own Strange Creatures

A deep-sea visual novel brought to life with interactive Live2D characters.

Click, touch, and interact with the characters. Your actions can become part of the story.

No light reaches the bottom.

Claris,the nation of water. Its twenty-third city, Abyssaria,

is the poorest and darkest place in the country.

The people here have no names. Only Management Numbers.

Those who were never made into fishfolk — who remain trapped in human bodies — carry air tanks on their backs, take on the labor no one else will, and buy each day's breath with ration coins.

Every night, in a city like that, Shion closes the door to his basement.

He is raising jellyfish, a creature the state has outlawed.

Discovery means prison. He does it for one reason only.

To buy his friend Calen her chance to become one of the fishfolk.

-A salvation called the Aquatic Serum-

At the age of three, children shed their numbers and receive the Aquatic Serum.

They are given a body optimized for the water, a new name, and a life lived as fishfolk.

That turn never comes for a child born in Abyssaria.

The raw material is running dry. The price climbs by the day.

Two paths remain: spend a lifetime waiting to be scouted,

or post overwhelming results at the National Academy and graduate into a career.

Calen drives her pen toward the second one with the only arm she has.

Shion knows that future does not add up — not on paper, not with the numbers she'll be paid.

So he chose another way. Smuggling.

Features

Live2D character interaction

Click the characters on screen and watch them react.

In some scenes, where you touched becomes part of the story itself.

A meticulously built deep-sea world

The Aquatic Serum and Kairos cells. Management Numbers and ration coins. The fishfolk caste and its jellyfish aristocracy. The Death Zone that forms the ceiling of the world.

Every piece of this setting closes in on the choices its characters make.

Characters

Calen, who wields cheerfulness like a weapon. Shion, who cannot say what he feels. Dalia, the school nurse with no sense of personal space. Formo, the student council president counting down what's left of her life. And classmates who never quite back off.

A story-driven visual novel about labor, choices, and the one person you can't afford to lose.

Free to play. No purchase required.

Abyssfall: The Black Citadel is a dark fantasy tower defense game that combines tactical tower placement, real-time hero combat, and a tabletop-inspired d20 Fate Dice system.

The abyss has opened, and its corruption is spreading across the realm. Demons, undead, and twisted creatures march toward your stronghold in relentless waves. To survive, you must build defenses, manage your gold, upgrade your towers, command a battle mage on the battlefield, and decide when to risk fate itself.

This is not a defense you watch from a distance. Your towers hold the line, but your mage can move where the battle is most dangerous, attack enemies directly, and cast spells when your defenses are under pressure. Every level challenges you to think strategically, react quickly, and decide where your power is needed most.

Hold the Line

Enemies advance along battlefield paths toward your base. Place towers in key locations, create defensive choke points, and stop the horde before it breaks through. As waves become stronger, your early decisions will shape whether your defense survives or collapses.

Command a Mage

Take direct control of a mage hero during combat. Move across the battlefield, strike enemies with magic, and cast spells to support your towers. Your hero is not just a passive upgrade — he is an active part of your defense.

Build, Upgrade, and Adapt

Earn gold during battle and spend it wisely. Build new towers to cover weak points, upgrade existing defenses to increase their power, and adapt your strategy as new enemy waves appear. Good resource management can be the difference between victory and defeat.

Hunt Fated Enemies

Some monsters enter the battlefield as Fated Enemies, empowered by unstable fate magic. These enemies are more dangerous than normal monsters. Defeating them rewards you with a D20 Fate Die, giving you a chance to bend the battle in your favor.

Roll the Fate Dice

Fate Dice are powerful but unpredictable. During combat, you can spend a Fate Die to draw three random fate effects, choose the one that best fits the situation, and then roll a d20 to determine the result.

A high roll can unleash a powerful blessing such as burst of damage, emergency gold, or temporary combat advantage. A low roll may fail completely. A natural 1 can backfire, turning your gamble into a dangerous setback.

Face Dark Fantasy Enemies

Fight corrupted monsters, undead warriors, and abyssal creatures that threaten your stronghold. Learn their behavior, respond to their movement, and prepare for increasingly dangerous waves.

Advance Toward the Black Citadel

At the center of the invasion stands the Black Citadel, a fortress of abyssal power. Battle through corrupted lands and push toward the source of the darkness as the world falls deeper into ruin.

Key Features

- Dark fantasy tower defense with real-time hero control

- Build and upgrade towers to stop enemy waves

- Directly control a battle mage during combat

- Cast spells and attack enemies where your defenses are weakest

- Manage gold, tower placement, and upgrades during each battle

- Hunt empowered Fated Enemies for D20 Fate Dice

- Choose from random fate effects and roll a d20 to determine the outcome

- High-risk, high-reward fate events with successes, failures, critical successes, and critical failures

- Fight demons, undead, and corrupted creatures

- Single-player campaign structure

- Keyboard and mouse controls

Step into the shoes of Leah Sharp, detective at Synaptic Investigations — a covert agency that uses neural synchronization technology to project its investigators directly into reconstructed crime scenes across time and space.

Explore. Investigate. Deduce.

Each case drops you into a unique location where a murder has taken place. Search every room, interact with objects, uncover clues, and piece together the truth using your Deduction Table: a logic grid where every mark brings you closer to the killer.

Key Features:

🔍 First-person investigation across multiple time periods and locations

🧠 Logic-based deduction system inspired by classic mystery puzzles

📓 Manual deduction table, no hand-holding, just your reasoning

🔎 Clues and puzzles to solve

⏱️ Multiple difficulty levels, from straightforward cases to complex investigations that will put your observation and deduction skills to the test

🔒 One suspect. One weapon. One location. Can you find the right combination?

The truth is out there. Nothing escapes time and space.

Do you love cats?

Then step into a world

where every cat can find a warm, loving home.

Discover 《Adorable Cat》!

《Adorable Cat》 is a cozy, relaxing idle desktop companion game where you can spend your days with adorable cats.
Even while you're busy with other things on your computer, your cats will be living their own little lives.
Drop by from time to time to feed them, spend time together, and enjoy watching their everyday lives.

Meet Your Cat in 《Adorable Cat》
Meet a variety of cats in the game.
You might even find one that looks just like the cat you share your life with!
Welcome your favorite cats into your family and keep them by your side every day.

1. Welcome All Kinds of Cats into Your Family

  • Meet cats with all kinds of unique personalities and charms, and welcome them into your family.

  • You might even find one that looks just like the cat you share your life with.

  • As your feline family grows, your little space will become livelier and even more adorable.

2. Take Care of Your Cats

  • Treat your cats to delicious food and take care of their needs.

  • Whenever they cross your mind, drop by and spend a little time together.

  • With your care and affection, your cats can enjoy even happier days.

      

3. Create a Cozy Home for Your Cats

  • Decorate a cozy home for your cats with a variety of furniture and toys.

  • Watch your cats relax, play, and enjoy their own little lives in the space you've created for them.

4. Complete missions and collect cats

  • Complete various missions as you play and fill up your cat collection.

    Earn various rewards by completing missions and expanding your collection.

Advancing Legion is an idle auto-battler game.
You play as a powerful hero, leading your people to rise from humble beginnings, gradually forming a massive legion to face wave after wave of surging enemies.

Story Background

On a continent of endless conflict, humans, demons, orcs, elves, dwarves, undead, and other races fight for survival.
You come from a weak race and are its hero.
You must lead them to survive, grow stronger, and even conquer other races, ultimately resisting the God Race's rule over the continent.

Build an Army

The game offers multiple races to choose from, including humans, demons, orcs, and more.
You will choose one race and gradually hire distinctive soldiers to form a massive legion.
Each soldier appears in the recruitment shop with different traits, so every legion you build is unique.

Idle Auto-Battle

Fully automatic real-time combat frees your hands completely.
Without frantic micromanagement, you can command thousands of troops and enjoy the thrill of conquest with ease.

Hero Development

The hero is the core of the legion.
You can choose different development paths for your hero and equip sets with various traits to create rich and varied hero forms.

Rich Set Equipment

The game features a rich set equipment system.
Equipment of different qualities has its own uses and can build ever-changing combat styles.

RISE, KNIGHT

The skies you were once promised have been taken hostage. Reclaim them alone or gather up to four friends and discover whether cooperation was a terrible mistake.

Aer Isles is a chaotic online co-op action game set across floating islands. Leap between them, survive dangerous encounters, battle strange creatures, and reach the beacon before your shared lives run out.

CROSS THE ISLES

Navigate bridges, wind lanes, and precarious jumps while enemies and hazards threaten to send your entire party into the clouds. Each expedition has a destination. Getting everyone there is the difficult part.

GATHER POWER. HIT HARDER.

Collect Power to strengthen your attacks and send enemies flying. Wield a swift katana or embrace the ancient art of the Bonk-but beware: Bokos can steal your Power.

SHARE THE ADVENTURE; AND THE CONSEQUENCES

Fight and travel together with online co-op and proximity voice chat. Your party shares a limited pool of lives, so every heroic rescue matters, and every poorly aimed Bonk becomes everyone’s problem.

Face the Isles alone or bring your friends. Cooperate, improvise, scream helpful instructions, and try not to launch the person carrying the team into the clouds.

Conquer the Aer Isles, or knock yourselves back trying.

Enter the Ink Realm

Aera in the Ink Realm is a third-person dark fantasy action RPG that combines fast-paced katana combat, martial arts, exploration, and a mysterious story set across corrupted storybook worlds.

After inheriting a long-abandoned ancient library, Aera and her friends discover books connected to another realm. When her friends are pulled into different stories, Aera must enter the Ink Realm, survive its twisted worlds, and uncover the truth hidden inside the library.

Master Fast-Paced Combat

Fight cursed samurai, corrupted knights, ink-born creatures, and powerful bosses using Aera’s katana, martial arts techniques, dodges, counters, and combat abilities.

Switch between precise sword attacks and close-range hand-to-hand combat as you adapt to different enemies and encounters.

Explore Corrupted Storybook Worlds

Travel through dark fantasy realms inspired by ancient legends, ruined kingdoms, cursed dojos, mysterious palaces, and broken fairy tales.

Each world features its own atmosphere, enemies, challenges, and secrets connected to the Ink Realm.

Uncover Aera’s Story

Follow a mysterious glowing manuscript left behind by Aera’s deceased relative. Discover why the library was abandoned, what happened to Aera’s friends, and what force is controlling the Ink Realm.

Features

·         Enter cursed living books and restore broken stories

·         Fast third-person action combat

·         Cinematic boss fights

·         Magical library hub with portals and secrets

·         Five dark fantasy book worlds

·         Story-driven progression

·         Female protagonist

·         Playable demo in development

Aera in the Ink Realm is currently in development. Features, visuals, and content may change before the final release.

1. Game Overview

Aetherantis: Realm of Fates is a turn-based strategy board game blending resource gathering, territory development and fate card mechanics, set within a whimsical fantasy mythos and crafted to deliver authentic tabletop gaming fun. Up to four players can compete locally on a single device, with options for free-for-all matches or 2v2 team battles. Thanks to Steam’s Remote Play Together feature, you can gather friends for a full game night without leaving home.

2. Core Gameplay

Territory Construction & Resource Economy (Core Strategy Loop)

Floating realm Aetherantis is blessed by ancient deities, with divine ore veins and natural resources scattered across its sprawling lands. As aspiring lords, players roll the dice to chart their expansion, stockpile resources from controlled land plots and build settlements and trading harbors. Strike trade deals across disparate city-states and pivot match outcomes with uniquely powered fate cards to rack up victory points and claim dominion over Aetherantis.

Unique Fate Card System

Boasting over 20 distinct fate cards, this original card mechanic adds rich competitive depth to every match. Draw cards mid-game to plunder rival resources, lock opponents out of trades, alter harbor exchange rates or temporarily seize production from enemy settlements; a well-timed card can turn a losing run into an unexpected comeback. Combine multiple cards in tandem to unlock countless creative tactical synergies.

Race for Expansion

Experience brand-new competitive racing gameplay, designed for fast-paced matches!

Floating maps mark exclusive starting and finishing points, and all players set off at the same time, extending the board by laying down star paths. You’ll need to plan your resources wisely, seize pathways, and even place obstacles to block your opponents. The adventurer who first builds their exclusive settlement on the finish tile wins the match!

Evolving Dynamic Map

The game board transforms every three turns. Terrain shifts rewrite familiar layouts. Adapt your strategies on‑the‑fly, no two matches play the same.

Fog‑of‑War Exploration

Large sections of the map lie hidden beneath mist, with valuable high‑output resource tiles waiting to be discovered. Invest actions to explore, use judgement and foresight to claim prime land first, and build decisive resource superiority against rivals.

Versatile Multiplayer Rules

Local multiplayer supports 1–4 players on one machine, featuring free-for-all skirmishes and competitive 2v2 team duels, making it an ideal tabletop pick for gatherings with friends.

3. Key Features

  • Procedurally Generated Maps: Every playthrough spawns unique land layouts and resource spawns, eliminating stale fixed-map meta. Random combinations of land tiles and harbors create shifting resource economies and expansion paths for endless replayability.

  • Fate Card Community Contest: Submit your custom card designs via our official community campaign. Standout creations will be implemented into the official in-game card roster with your designer credit attached, growing the game alongside our player base.

  • Watercolor Hand-Painted Art Style: The entire game—board maps, playable characters and UI elements—is rendered in soft hand-drawn watercolor art, crafting an ethereal, mysterious fantasy atmosphere.

  • Local Couch Co-op for Up to 4 Players: Gather around one screen for classic tabletop matches, perfect for home nights and group hangouts. Full support for both keyboard & mouse and gamepad controllers.

The Convergence tore reality apart. The ley lines broke, the sky cracked, and things long buried climbed out of the depths. You woke at the edge of the Verdant Reach with a blade and a faint pulse of Aethyr in your chest. Everything ahead, the cursed forests, the volcanic wastes, the shattered isles and the Abyss below them, is yours to push through one tick at a time.

An idle RPG you actually get to build

Aethyr Idle fights for you once it's set up, but setting it up is the game. You choose a class, shape a talent tree, craft and enchant your gear, and write the spell rotation your hero runs in combat. Leave it in a tab and come back to loot, levels and a fight still in progress. The depth isn't in pressing buttons faster, it's in the build you assemble.

Combat you design, not just watch

  • Write a spell rotation and attach conditions to each spell: cast only below an HP threshold, only on bosses, only while a buff is up, only with enough poison stacks. The rotation adapts itself and skips what doesn't fit.

  • Talents don't just hand you "+X% damage". They rewrite how spells behave: bleeds that last twice as long, fire that burns, frost that freezes, poison that stacks higher, buffs that stun or generate energy.

  • Six elements interact through a type chart: bring the right element against an enemy and you hit for more, the wrong one and you hit for less. Your weapon's element is yours to transmute, so the matchup is a choice, not a roll.

  • Energy is a second combat resource that fills as you attack and feeds one of seven playstyles, up to a Discharge that ignores all mitigation.

  • A live damage report breaks down exactly where your damage comes from, so you can stop guessing whether your build does what you think it does.

Four classes, twelve specializations

You start as a Vagabond and choose your class: Warrior, Mage, Ranger or Rogue. Each one opens a talent tree with a shared foundation and then three full specializations, twelve in total, each with its own mechanics and a capstone that defines the build.

Elements and weapons

Every weapon you craft is bound to one of six elements: Fire, Ice, Earth, Air, Light or Shadow. Each grants passives that escalate as your energy bar fills, plus a unique Discharge effect. Don't like the element you rolled? Transmute it instead of recrafting the whole weapon.

A world to gather, craft and build

Gather wood, ore, fish and game across every zone, then craft through smithing, leatherworking, woodworking, jewelry, enchanting, alchemy and cooking, hundreds of recipes feeding hundreds of items. The ley lines quietly harvest Aethyr in the background while you play.

Endgame that doesn't stop at the level cap

Level 100 isn't the finish line, it's where the endgame opens.

Run dungeons, then their Mythic+ versions that scale as far as your build can hold, with affixes that change the rules each push.

Descend the Abyss, a roguelike run where you pick a blessing between floors and rewards climb the deeper you dive.

Fight onto the Celestial Islands, floating zones with elite enemies and mechanics found nowhere else, and the resources to push your gear to its limits.

Then there's the slow burn: Ascension passives, Mythic Imperatives that buff you in every mode at once, gear affixes and a full enchanting suite of runes, reforging, fusion, augmentation and infusion, and 33 familiars that fight beside you and reshape how you play.

Play to compete, or just to play

Climb leaderboards across several categories, or ignore them entirely and progress at your own pace. Story quests, dailies and a long list of achievements give you something to chase either way.

You wake in an unfamiliar place with no clear memory of who you are or how you got there.

Move through a series of strange and increasingly unstable spaces, where familiar things begin to feel unfamiliar.

Recover traces of someone who disappeared, follow fragments of a layered narrative, manage your sanity, and encounter the figures that move through the forest. Are they enemies, memories, or something else?

A Study on Disappearing Completely is the first episode of a planned trilogy.

Approximately 1–1.5 hours, made by a solo developer.
