After Hue is a charming puzzle-platformer where an adorable chameleon embarks on a grand adventure!

Discover the secrets hidden within the colors!

Change colors, alter states, and solve the puzzles in your path!

Key Features

  • Adorable animal characters

  • Approx. 1 hour of playtime

  • A wordless gameplay experience

  • Dynamic color-shifting mechanics

Wake with nothing

You start with a notebook and a salvaged tablet carrying a hand-drawn map of the country. It fills in as you walk. Nothing else.

Keep fed, watered and warm. Night, winter, rain, snow and wading through rivers all chill you; clothes and a fire warm you, and a fire goes out if nobody feeds it. Cuts keep bleeding until you bind them.

Find it, learn it, build it

  • Research without levels: find notes and schematics in the ruins, then work them out at a bench to learn new crafts. Knowledge is shared by the whole camp. No XP bar.

  • From stone to steel: tools and weapons start as wood and stone; later you smelt steel from ore and scrap at a forge. Armour goes from cloth to leather to plate.

  • Weapons: craft blades, spears, bows and crossbows. Revolvers and rifles are rare finds.

  • Build a camp room by room: walls upgrade from wood to stone to steel, and doors from wood to steel.

  • Defend it: raise lookouts, store water, cure meat in a smoker, and run a generator for an electric fence, a wired gate, an alarm bell and floodlights salvaged from town walls.

  • Go further: bigger packs for longer trips, and bicycles found chained in towns that you can mend and ride.

Live off the land

  • Grow potatoes, beans, squash and more through four seasons. Summer is good, autumn is slow and nothing grows in winter.

  • Hunt, set snares and traps, fish, butcher, cook, and preserve food on a drying rack, in a smoker, in pickling jars and in a larder, because food spoils.

  • Barter with traders, walled farms and travellers across the map.

  • Tame a wild dog by feeding it night after night. It follows you, carries saddlebags and fetches.

  • Travellers you help can come to live at your camp. They keep the fire fed, tend the crops, mend damage and fight off attackers, and they can die for good.

Enemies who keep count

  • Rival factions hold the towns and camps. Each keeps its own count of how loud and violent you've been on its ground, and remembers where it lost men. Push one too far and it sends a raiding party after you.

  • Raiders hear you in every direction but only see what's in front of them. They come at you from several sides, some of them carry grenades, and if you're home, they come to your camp.

  • Take their camps to cool their anger, or clear them all and the raids stop.

  • Weather is cover: rain and storms drown out your noise, and storms and fog cut everyone's sight.

  • Not everyone is hostile. Some will trade, some want payment to let you pass, and some will tell you once to leave.

Somewhere to go

  • Two story threads lead you across the map and beneath it.

  • Side jobs from traders, cabins and people on the road, paid in supplies, schematics and standing deals.

  • The road east ends two ways. Neither of them is the good one.

Your world, your rules

  • Co-op for up to five over Steam's relay network: join through a friend's lobby, and nobody ever learns another player's IP address. One persistent world, hosted by whoever started it.

  • Set the rules for each world: what happens on death (drop your pack, keep it, or Hardcore, where a dead survivor is gone for good), raids, night packs, day length, seasons, regrowth, appetite and friendly fire.

  • 31 Steam achievements, and the game is fully translated into English, German, French, Spanish, Brazilian Portuguese, Italian, Polish and Russian.

A roguelike deckbuilder where you can customise your deck with thousands of unique cards. Upgrade, draft, and buy new cards, and use powerful items on a unique battlefield that favours battlefield movement and card play.

Master the five factions and stand Against the Horde.

Features

  • Hundreds of cards to incorporate into your deck.

  • Five unique factions to play as with varying playstyles.

  • Hundreds of unique enemy cards and events to encounter.

  • A huge variety of upgrades, items, and unique event cards to fully customise your deck to your unique playstyle.

  • A different style of combat, where the cards you play need to be strategically placed on the board.

  • Difficult combats with a variety of corruption difficulties to make the game harder if you choose

Age of Failon – Birth of the Hero is a dark fantasy turn-based strategy game focused on map exploration and tactical grid combat, inspired by classic old-school strategy titles.

The game is built around one massive, continuous campaign where your goal is to grow your hero, build your army, and develop your stronghold. Across 30 chapters and over 350 maps, your entire progression carries over from mission to mission. Along the way, you'll complete map objectives and follow Failon's story through in-game dialogues.

Key Features

  • One Massive Story Campaign: Follow Failon’s journey across 350+ maps and 30 chapters with persistent progression—nothing resets when you move to the next map.

  • 6 Playable Realms: Choose from Kingdom, Wildlands, Nature, Underworld, Void, and Heavens, each with its own units and buildings.

  • Persistent UI Stronghold: Your town lives directly in the UI rather than on the adventure map. You develop it throughout the entire campaign, constructing 19 buildings that can each be upgraded up to Level 50.

  • 4 Eras & Unit Evolutions: Advance your stronghold through four distinct Eras, unlocking a new visual and combat evolution for every unit line along the way.

  • Deep Hero Progression (Up to Level 250): Continuously level up Failon and spend Hero Points and Skill Points to boost core attributes or unlock new abilities.

  • Upgradeable Spellbook: Discover new magic spells as you progress and level them up to increase their power in combat.

  • Tactical Combat & No Weekly Spawns: Forget waiting for weekly creature growth—earn and recruit new units through exploration and battle, then command up to 7 stacks on a tactical battlefield.

One world. Three ages. The same war.

Ages TD is a story-driven tower defense inspired by the classic Warcraft III custom maps. You defend a single world as it lives through its ages: the village you save with spear towers in the Ancient era becomes the walled town your ballistae defend in the Medieval one, and the neon city your railguns hold in the Modern day.

The horde evolves with you. Every counter you invent, the enemy answers. Block the pass - they send Breakers. Burn the bridge - they take to the sky. Nothing you learn is wasted, and nothing stays safe.

Towers that work together. Tar slows the horde into a killing pool for fire pots. Barbed spears make poison bite harder. Totems of the ancestors wake the men on the towers.

A story told in the thick of battle. The Elder counts his hens, the Watchman counts the horde, the Priestess reads four-hundred-year-old frescoes with a familiar face on them. And something behind the portals counts... you.

  • 18 levels across three eras, each with its own tactics

  • Bosses with real mechanics: shields to break, healers to silence, regeneration to outpace

  • Tower synergies and irreversible doctrine choices

  • Fully localized: English, Ukrainian, Russian

Lead an Agile software team through a year of impossible deadlines, executive surprises, sprint planning, and workplace chaos.  Every decision shapes your team, your product, and your chance of shipping on time.

Building software is hard.

Building software while Sales promises impossible features, Marketing wants a flashy demo by Friday, executives invent new priorities every sprint, and developers insist "it'll only take two more weeks"... that's the real challenge.

Agile Team is a humorous narrative management game where you step into the role of a Product Owner leading a software team racing to launch a brand-new video streaming platform in just one year.

Every sprint brings new challenges.

Will you protect your developers from endless interruptions or keep stakeholders happy?  Do you prioritize technical debt or ship the feature Marketing desperately needs?  Can you survive the latest executive initiative without derailing the entire roadmap?

There are no perfect decisions—only trade-offs.

You'll guide sprint planning, manage personalities, balance morale against delivery, and navigate the wonderfully absurd realities of modern software development.  Every choice influences your team, your relationships, and ultimately whether your product launches successfully or not.

Whether you've spent years in Agile—or simply enjoy strategy games driven by memorable characters and meaningful choices—you'll recognize the humour, frustration, and surprisingly human moments behind every sprint.

Features

  • Lead a software development team building a new video streaming service.

  • Meet a cast of unique developers, designers, managers, executives, and stakeholders with their own personalities and agendas.

  • Make difficult decisions where every choice comes with consequences.

  • Balance delivery, quality, morale, technical debt, and stakeholder expectations.

  • Experience narrative events inspired by real software development stories.

  • Discover dozens of workplace situations every Agile professional secretly wishes were fictional.

  • Choose your team, build the beta, then Launch!

AIRSPACE MASTER

Manage both approach/departure air traffic and ground operations in a simple top down 2D air traffic control (ATC ) interface designed for clarity and fast decision-making. From guiding incoming aircraft safely to coordinating departures and taxi movements in the most efficient way possible!.

Objective

Handle as many aircraft as possible without collapsing your operation.

  • Maintain your Operational Integrity (OI), your performance meter

  • Avoid mistakes, delays, and dangerous situations

  • Complete dynamic requests that can help or hurt your OI

Push your limits and see how long you can keep everything running under pressure.

Gameplay

Control aircraft using simple, intuitive commands:

  • Adjust altitude (climb / descend) and speed with 3 clear levels 

  • Change heading and assign waypoints

  • Authorize final approach and departures

  • Manage ground traffic:

    • Taxi operations

    • Line up and hold

    • Takeoff clearance

Each airport is designed to stay readable and manageable, avoiding unnecessary complexity while still offering depth and fun. 

 Dynamic World

  • Day/Night cycle with adjustable speed

  • Dynamic weather, including rain clouds that affect ground visibility and radar operations

  • Increasing traffic complexity over time

  • Unexpected situations and emergencies that test your control

  • Special requests that introduce special traffic and changing conditions


Full control over:

  • Traffic density

  • Emergencies toggle (on/off)

  • Weather conditions toggle (on/off)

  • building traffic mechanics (on/off)

  • requests mode (on/off)

  • Game speed

Airports

Start with 11 unique airports (More in the future), each with its own operational challenges

  • BOGOTA, COLOMBIA

  • BOZEMAN, UNITED STATES

  • GIBRALTAR, UNITED KINGDOM

  • JEJU ISLAND, SOUTH KOREA

  • NAIROBI, KENYA

  • OSLO, NORWAY

  • PERTH, AUSTRALIA

  • QUEBEC, CANADA

  • QUERETARO, MEXICO

  • RIO DE JANEIRO, BRAZIL

  • TEL AVIV, ISRAEL

Steam Workshop Support

Expand your airspace with community-created content:

  • Custom airline visuals

  • Custom traffic datasets

Aiya Desire is an exploration × rhythm game × horror adventure in which you explore the massive radio tower Sentinel and uncover the truth behind the neural-linked chip known as HC.

Search rooms, collect items, and piece together clues from conversations and logs. Face approaching enemies and unsettling horror sequences.
Then, when boss battles begin, the game shifts from exploration horror into a 2-button rhythm battle, where you confront “something” that tries to interfere with the mind of the protagonist, Aiya.

Exploration, puzzles, and rhythm boss battles

Inside Sentinel, strange rooms, hidden logs, surveillance devices, and mechanisms that react to light and sound await.

As Aiya, you will explore the tower, gather clues, and solve the puzzles built into its distorted spaces.
But the closer you get to the truth, the more unstable the world becomes.

Vision warps.
Sound breaks apart.
The signal Refluxes.
Reality begins to lose its shape.

  • Exploration: Investigate rooms, gather items, read logs, and uncover clues through dialogue.

  • Puzzle solving: Use cameras, lights, candles, and other mechanisms to open the way forward.

  • Rhythm boss battles: Fight back with simple two-button inputs synced to the music.

  • Psychological horror: Visuals and sound shift as Aiya’s mental state deteriorates.

↑A chameleon-eyed enemy that sees every blind spot. Meccha scary.

Salvation, or control?

In the near future, AI has optimized almost every part of society.
And yet, war has not disappeared.

Eventually, the AIs reach a terrible conclusion.
Not bullets. Not bombs.
A biological weapon — a virus that invades the human mind.

The world collapses into an infection crisis.
People live in fear of hallucinations, panic, confusion, and mental breakdown.

Then, in the middle of that despair, a new device appears:

HC — the Harmony Chip.

A neural wearable chip said to calm fear, suppress confusion, and protect the human mind.
It spreads rapidly across the world.

Humanity is saved.
At least, that is what everyone believes.

But something is wrong.

Those who refuse to wear HC begin to change.
Even without any sign of infection, they suffer hallucinations, violent confusion, and personality collapse.
Many are forced into quarantine zones, and the divide between HC users and non-users grows deeper.

The missing father, the dead mother, and the black chip

Aiya’s father was one of the brilliant scientists who helped develop HC.

Once, he loved his daughter more than anything.
But one day, he began to distance himself from her.

A few days later, Aiya’s mother died under mysterious circumstances.
Her father disappeared.

An empty house.
The faint smell of iron.
A strange electronic noise coming from behind the walls.

In her father’s study, Aiya finds a handwritten message — and a black chip she has never seen before.

“To save the people connected to HC, I am going to Sentinel.
Use this chip.
There is no time left.”

At that moment, every monitor in the house turns on at once.

《Unauthorized individual detected. Recovery protocol initiated.》

Is her father an enemy?
Or is he trying to save her?

Did HC truly save humanity?
Or is something hidden beneath that so-called salvation?

Aiya’s nightmare begins.

Key Features

  • An exploration horror adventure with rhythm-game boss battles.

  • A near-future story about salvation, surveillance, and control.

  • Explore the massive signal tower Sentinel and uncover the truth behind HC.

  • Gather clues through rooms, items, logs, and dialogue.

  • Solve environmental puzzles using cameras, lights, candles, and other mechanisms.

  • Face bosses in two-button rhythm battles.

  • Experience psychological horror through shifting visuals, unstable sound, and distorted reality.

Streaming & Video Policy

  • You may stream, record, review, clip, and share gameplay of Aiya Desire, including the demo and full release, without prior permission.

  • Monetization on platforms such as YouTube, Twitch, TikTok, and X is allowed for both individuals and organizations.

  • Full playthroughs, boss battles, endings, and spoiler content are permitted.

  • Please do not redistribute the game files, soundtrack, or visual assets as standalone materials, imply official endorsement, or violate the rules of the platform you use.

At 5:00 PM, she always dies.

Akeno no Yosuga - Twilight Loop - is a time-loop psychological horror adventure about a man trapped in the cycle of a girl's death, desperately trying to save her from a day that repeats again and again.

Every day at 5:00 PM, a girl named Akane inevitably dies.
Prevent the accident. Change your actions. Make different choices—
the outcome remains the same: Akane dies.

Realizing that something is terribly wrong, the protagonist, Keita, relives the same day over and over in an attempt to save her.

Why does she have to die?
Why does the world demand her death?
And—who is it that truly needs to be saved?

With every choice, tiny cracks begin to appear in a world that should be exactly the same as yesterday.
Eventually, the story converges on the truth hidden between the two of them.

■ Features

・Multiple endings shaped by your choices
・A time-loop structure built around reliving the same day
・Dialogue and scenes that change with each loop
・Psychological horror exploring death, self-sacrifice, and distorted love
・A mystery where scattered clues gradually converge on the truth

■ Themes

・Can fate be changed?
・The choice to die for someone else
・The boundary between salvation and dependence

Can you bring this loop to an end?

Akuro & Bahaku: Battle Against Pollution Monsters is an innovative auto-battle game that combines Brick Building with Roguelite Exploration. As Akuro and Bahaku are ambushed and captured by Dr. Evil, you will take control of one character—Akuro or Bahaku—and under the guidance of Dr. Fox, use the "Combat Bricks" developed by Dr. Fox to strengthen yourself. Delve into the randomly generated labyrinth made up of hundreds of rooms—the Evil Lab—and uncover Dr. Evil's earth-shattering conspiracy!

  • 🧩 Strategic Brick Building System: The core of the game is not about simple level grinding, but about deep "Brick" combinations. You will collect and assemble Bricks with various functions (affecting dozens of attributes such as Attack, Defense, Attack Speed, Crit Rate, and Energy Drain), and use their placement to trigger Synergy effects, creating a unique combat build. Over a hundred powerful "Legendary Bricks" await your discovery—they will completely transform your combat style!

  • 🗺️ Never-Repeating Labyrinth Exploration: Each time you enter, the map is randomly generated from hundreds of tightly connected rooms. From standard battle rooms and treasure rooms, to special service rooms such as Purchase Rooms, Expansion Rooms, and Modification Rooms, to danger-filled Mimics and Fake Hot Springs—every expedition is a brand-new adventure. Every choice you make will affect the course of your journey.

⚔️ Thrilling Auto-Battle Action: Combat runs automatically, but strategy is in your hands! You need to assign targets based on enemy traits with careful consideration. In battle, your character may be captured, corrupted, or even completely overwhelmed, leading to various challenging "bad endings" that make every decision carry real weight.

  • 💔 Massive Defeat CG Collection: The game features meticulously crafted exclusive defeat CGs for every character-and-monster combination, and different final endings also come with their own independent ending CGs. These CGs include elements such as torn clothing, slime corruption, and defiant defeat, rendered in a delicate art style with high collectible value. For players who love the emotional tension between characters, completing the entire gallery will become one of the indispensable joys of the journey! Of course, if this doesn't interest you, you can also skip all CGs with a single click in the settings and enjoy pure tactical combat without any distraction — the gameplay experience remains just as complete, and the choice is entirely yours.

  • 🎭 A Plot Full of Twists and Turns: What secrets lie behind the seemingly helpful Dr. Fox? As you collect all four keys and unlock the laboratory's hidden chamber, a conspiracy involving "special energy" and a "Pollution Monster army" will gradually surface. Are you the hero saving the world, or just a pawn being used? The truth awaits your discovery.

This is not just a battle—it is a survival challenge filled with unknowns and strategy. Every adventure brings new enemies, new Bricks, and new abilities. It is time to lead Akuro and Bahaku and break out of the Evil Lab swarming with Pollution Monsters!

The Old Alchemist's Storage Awaits You

Deep inside the forgotten storage of an old alchemist, countless mysterious potions are waiting to be discovered. Organize the shelves, uncover lost recipes, and bring this magical storage back to life.

Alchemist's Books: Sorting the Old Alchemist's Storage is a calm and cozy potion-sorting experience. Your goal is simple: discover potions, learn their properties, and organize them on the correct shelves.

🍵 2,532 Unique Potions

There are 2,532 different potions waiting to be discovered throughout the storage. Each potion has its own unique recipe. Discovering them all and completing your collection won't be easy.

📖 Discover the Recipes

Every potion is part of a recipe hidden within the old alchemist's books. As you organize potions, discover new recipes and slowly uncover the mysteries of alchemy.

🪄 Organize Your Shelves

Place potions on the shelves, group matching types together, and organize the storage your own way.

🌿 A Cozy Alchemy Experience

There's no need to rush. Gather potions, discover their secrets, organize them, and enjoy the old alchemist's storage at your own pace.

2,532 potions. Countless shelves to organize.

Are you ready to uncover the old alchemist's legacy?

🎧️❗ ATTENTION ❗🎧️

🎧 Headphones are recommended while using this ability so you can hear the potion sounds more clearly.

Alchemy Duel

Alchemy × Card Battle × Roguelike.
A single-player pixel-art card game where you aim to conquer all eight stages through ever-changing combinations and strategies.

Key Features

Synthesize through alchemy
Combine Material Cards to craft new Buddy Cards.
Each Buddy has unique effects, and summoning the right one at the right time is the key to victory.

Tactical turn-based battles
The placement of Buddy Cards affects their synergy with other Buddies, Relics, and enemy attacks.
Like auto-chess, positioning is part of the strategy.

Enhance your deck with Relics
Purchase Relics in shops after battles to empower your Buddies.
Relic combinations allow for limitless strategic possibilities.

Roguelike challenges
Enemies and rewards change with every run.
How you manage your resources determines your success.
Even in defeat, new combinations await, offering high replayability.

A world of alchemical battles in pixel art
Retro-style visuals and animated monsters bring each battle to life.

Aldmark Calls for Aid is a medieval siege-defence game with no base-building and no resource management. Command your troops directly, and between rounds choose where to light the beacons that call allies to your aid. Every battle earns renown, win or lose, to spend on unlocking and upgrading troops, enhancing your realm, strengthening your defences, and more. Maps are procedurally generated, each level bigger than the last, and victory doesn't have to be the end: keep fighting and see how long you can withstand the siege of Aldmark.

  • Command: manoeuvre your troops around the battlefield, man the walls to prevent the enemy reaching the city, and protect your supply lines to ensure that the city doesn't starve.

  • Survive: the enemy will bring battering rams to break through your gate, ladders to scale your walls, and catapults to destroy them. 

  • Scout: preview the lands around Aldmark to see what allies you can call on before committing to placing a beacon.

  • Light: place and light the beacon to call upon your allies. The further away they are, the longer they take to reach you.

  • Renown: win or lose, every battle earns renown which is spent on perks in the Muster. 

  • Muster: spend renown to upgrade your soldiers, unlock new troops, build fortifications, recruit mercenary companies, and more. 

  • Map: switch the battlefield from the default colour mode to a sepia style that mimics a parchment campaign map look. The same can be done for soldiers or you can mix and match.

  • Soldiers: change the colours of soldiers or even turn them into shapes. These options can be helpful for visibility or just for a more abstract play style.

  • Monarchs: create up to 3 profiles which keep track of your progress; your current siege, level unlocks, renown, and muster perks.

  • Edicts: choose how you want to play; disable gore, adjust the size of the HUD interface, change key bindings, and more.

Brew the periodic table into a card game.

Alembix is a free-to-play collectible card game where every creature is an element, every spell a reaction, and every fusion a real chemical recipe. Recruit the noble metals and the volatile gases, transmute them in your Athanor, and out-think your opponent in fast, decisive duels built on a periodic-table you didn't know was a battlefield.

No grinding for resources. No paywalled cards. Every card in the game is craftable.

What makes Alembix different

  • 120 creatures, one for every element. From the alkali firestarters to the radiant rare earths, each tribe plays to its real-world character. Salia burn fast. Terrae hold the line. Aetheria slip every attack.

  • Fusion that actually means something. Bring iron and oxygen onto the field and forge them into Crocus — rust given form. 22 initial  fusion recipes, each a genuine reaction. Your component creatures are consumed in the transmutation; choose your moment.

  • The Athanor. Five fusions, chosen before the match. Your secret weapon, hidden until you draw it from the furnace.

  • A clean resource system you'll learn in a minute. Quintessence ramps each turn like mana you already know. Three alchemical primes — Salt, Sulphur, Mercury — come from the creatures you play, never from a card you didn't draw. No mana screw. No missing colours. Just the choices that matter.

  • Easy to learn, deep to master. The opening tutorial gets you into a real duel in under ten minutes. The meta will take longer.

How it plays

Each turn you gain a little more Quintessence and choose how to spend it: drop an element creature onto the field, play an event to bend the rules, or perform a fusion if you've set the stage. Your creatures emit primes while they live, unlocking your bigger plays. Your opponent does the same. Turns are quick. Decisions aren't.

The Athanor sits beside the board the whole match: five Coagula you chose before the duel began, waiting for the right components to land on your side. Bring them out at the right moment and you can swing a game. Bring them out too soon and you've spent your engine.

Built fair from the ground up

Alembix is free-to-play and built to stay that way honestly.

  • Every card is craftable. Dismantle duplicates into Stardust, craft the card you want. No card is paywalled, but crafting is driven by random generation.

  • Disclosed odds. Every booster pack shows its drop rates, pity timers, and duplicate protection before you buy or open it.

  • No pay-to-win. Spending accelerates collection breadth, not card power. The best cards are reachable for everyone.

  • No blockchain. No NFTs. No off-platform trading. Your cards live on your account, full stop.

  • Account-bound, server-side, undo-protected. Mistakes are recoverable. Trades, when they arrive in a future update, will be safe by default.

Features at launch

  • 120 element creatures across 9 alchemical tribes

  • 22 Coagula fusion recipes built on real chemistry

  • 26 event cards — operations and reactions, the alchemist's tricks

  • Ranked and unranked PvP duels

  • Solo play against the Athanor AI for practice and dailies

  • Four pack tiers (Verdant free / Azure / Crimson / Gilded)

  • Full crafting and dismantle economy with Stardust

  • A scripted tutorial that takes you from "what's a Quintessence" to your first fusion in one sitting

  • Seasonal events and rotating limited mini-sets

For the curious

You don't need to know any chemistry to play. But if you do, you'll notice things. The flame-test colours your creatures glow with. The molecules your fusions produce. The reasons sodium and chlorine love each other. Alembix is built on real science the way a great fantasy is built on real myth — quietly, in the foundations, never as a lecture.

Alembix will launch into Early Access. The full card set, ranked play, and the Athanor are in. We'll be adding seasons, tribes events, social features, and trading as the community grows. Join us early, shape the meta, and brew with us.

Alien's Fridge


One slip sparks fear, one misstep makes it clear.

Overview:
Alien's Fridge is a 2D roguelike horror physics-based platformer where you step into the shoes of a brave boy scout trapped in a cave infested with ravenous aliens. Fight for your survival as you gather crucial upgrades and face a formidable final boss in this relentless battle.

Gameplay


  • Intense Challenge: Every level ramps up the difficulty, demanding quick reflexes and smart strategies.
  • Diverse Enemies: From minions that grab you, spiders that lock you down, and snakes that leap, to birds that transform into additional threats when you hesitate—every enemy is out to get you.
  • Physics-Based Action: Use realistic physics to your advantage; every jump, dodge, and collision is a matter of survival.
  • Upgrade & Strategy: Collect and utilize upgrades to improve your abilities and turn the tide in your favor.

Key Features


  • Roguelike Horror Experience: A unique blend of roguelike elements and horror aesthetics that keeps you on edge.
  • Realistic Physics Mechanics: Engage in combat and platforming where every movement is influenced by genuine physics.
  • Adaptive Enemy Behavior: Encounter foes that escalate the challenge as you progress—mistakes can be fatal.
  • High-Stakes Gameplay: One wrong move can spell disaster; precision and quick thinking are key.

Frequently Asked Questions (FAQs)


  • What makes Alien's Fridge unique among platformers?
    Very few 2D platformers feature a horror-themed, physics-based gameplay. Experience a unique blend of challenging platforming and an eerie atmosphere unlike any other.

  • How does the physics system affect gameplay?
    The physics system allows aliens to pull or push you around, leaving you feeling vulnerable and on edge. This dynamic interaction adds an extra layer of challenge to every encounter.

  • What types of power-ups are available?
    There are three categories of power-ups: weapons (e.g., pistol, rifles, etc.), weapon upgrades (e.g., improved precision, altered recoil, bounce effects, auto-targeting) and abilities (e.g., dash, triple jump, teleportation, slow time).

  • How does the difficulty evolve as you progress?
    As you progress, you'll encounter more and stronger enemies. The exit is farther away, there are more empty rooms off the main path, and everything gets increasingly challenging.

About Us


We are a passionate two-man team, balancing our dream of creating an unforgettable game with the realities of daily life. Our commitment is to deliver an experience that’s both challenging and immensely satisfying for players looking to add a bit of adrenaline to their day.

Choose your sect

Five sects are planned for Path to Ascension at the start of Early Access. The Tianhe Sword Sect fights with flying swords. The Taiyue Qianji Sect fields cannons and puppets. Dongting Artificer City fits components to carriers, Penglai Astral Pavilion rewards careful placement and timing, and the Hanhai Nether Cult raises Gu as its artifacts cast.

The free demo lets you play a run as Tianhe or Qianji.

Which artifact belongs in this sector?

Methods, artifacts and materials each have their own ring on the Bagua board. Before moving an artifact, check which sectors your method covers, when the artifact fires and what the materials beside it add.

Spend Spirit Stones at a shop to pick up a piece for your next fight, or keep it in your backpack until you find a place for it. Equipping artifacts costs Divine Sense. Exceeding your capacity reduces your maximum health.

Watch the fight and choose when to open your Domain

Hunt beasts or face builds left by other players in asynchronous duels. Artifacts fire as their cooldowns and trigger conditions allow. Watch the order of attacks, then swap an artifact or move its materials before the next fight.

Once you reach Divinity and obtain a Domain, wait for it to charge and choose when to unleash it. Each side can do this once per battle. When both Domains are active, their suppression effects cancel out and each side keeps its own bonuses.
